'''''Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika''''' was a five-issue series of comics published between [[2000]] and [[2001]].

It recounts the madcap adventure to retrieve the fabled [[Yavin Vassilika]] for a trio of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] competing to see who could gather the most talented team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].

The chase included [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]], [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], and even the mysterious [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. In the end, the Vassilika was found outside the rim, and nabbed by one of the Hutt's assistants, [[Jozzel Moffet]], on behalf of the Rebel Alliance (and Han's old flame, [[Bria Tharen]]). The Vassilika, it turns out, contained a key to an ancient [[Massassi Temple (disambiguation)|Massassi Temple]] which would provide the Alliance with a [[Great Temple/Legends|strategic outpost]].
